description: Use this when someone asks when their hair salon has free appointment slots or the next opening. Returns, per day, how many online-booking slots are open plus the first start and last end time, for the next 14 days that have openings (no client or stylist names). Not for making a booking.

salonId.description: Id of one of the user's salons, as the salon list returns it (24 lowercase hex characters)

name: get_salon_availability

days.description: One row per day with open online-booking slots inside the salon's booking window, in date order. Slot counts and times only; who holds a booked time is never exposed.

firstSlot.description: Start time of the first open slot that day

lastSlot.description: End time of the last open slot that day

title: Find free appointment slots
